summary: Frontend-only testing of the new AVATAR system (Dressing Room, Home rank bar avatar, Shred City YOU, Sticker Book button). All 9 flows pass. No pageerrors on Home / Dressing Room / Sticker Book / Shred City.

test_results.home_rank_bar_avatar: PASS — [data-testid=home-avatar] default data-chosen='false', img ends charlie.png, NEW tag present. Click → /#/dressing-room (not /sticker-book). Clicking elsewhere on home-progress-card → /#/sticker-book.
test_results.dressing_room_fresh_polliwog: PASS — page testid present, label 'Pick your Jelly!', name 'Charlie', count '8 / 30 outfits unlocked', 8 character picks (charlie, finn, chunk, jazzy, stew, doctor, sharky, lou).
test_results.pick_sharky: PASS — avatar-name = 'Sharky', label changes to 'Your Jelly', localStorage jma_avatar_v1 = {"character":"sharky","outfit":"classic"}. outfit-classic data-unlocked='true' + data-worn='true'; outfit-hiphop/snorkel/zoot data-unlocked='false' with correct hints: 'Earn your first badge', 'Practice 3 days in a row', 'Reach Apprentice rank'.
test_results.locked_click_no_change: PASS — clicking locked outfit-hiphop while locked does not change jma_avatar_v1.
test_results.badge_unlock_via_sticker: PASS — writing jma_stickers_v1={ach_ear_cadet:{earnedAt:...}} and reloading flips Sharky's outfit-hiphop to data-unlocked='true'. Count becomes '14 / 30' (classic 8 + 6 FIRST_BADGE outfits: charlie-disco, finn-disco, chunk-disco, jazzy-disco, sharky-hiphop, lou-disco). Clicking it sets data-worn='true' and jma_avatar_v1.outfit='hiphop'; preview img ends 'sharky-hiphop.png'.
test_results.home_shows_avatar_after_pick: PASS — on /#/home, [data-testid=home-avatar] data-chosen='true', no NEW tag, img ends 'sharky-hiphop.png'; a small rank badge icon is overlaid (second img inside the avatar container).
test_results.shred_city_crowd: PASS — with jma_unlock_all_v1='1' on /#/shred-legend → click shred-song-0 → crowd meter appears. [data-testid=shred-crowd-row] contains exactly 7 imgs and [data-testid=shred-crowd-you]; img at index 3 ends 'sharky-hiphop.png'.
test_results.sticker_book_button: PASS — [data-testid=open-dressing-room] visible on /#/sticker-book; clicking navigates to /#/dressing-room.
test_results.switch_character_regression: PASS — clicking avatar-pick-charlie updates jma_avatar_v1 to {character:'charlie',outfit:'classic'}; wardrobe grid shows 10 Charlie outfit tiles. With ach_ear_cadet badge: classic + disco data-unlocked='true'; surf/punk/zoot/rundmc/steampunk/studio/drummajor/grad data-unlocked='false' with proper hints.
test_results.regression_no_pageerrors: PASS — zero pageerrors across /home, /dressing-room, /sticker-book, /shred-legend. Daily quest card still renders on Home (9 daily-quest testid elements).

critical_code_review_comments: Minor React warning observed on initial load: 'Encountered two children with the same key' (not related to avatar code; appears unrelated to this feature and was present in prior iterations too — flagging for main agent to investigate the duplicate key source if not already).
Expected noise: assets/voice/*.mp3 → 401s and ignored Vimeo 401s, per prompt.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage keys: jma_player_name_skipped_v1='1', jma_reveal_seen_v1='1', jma_audio_unlocked_v1='1', jma_stickers_v1 with ach_ear_cadet for badge-unlock case, jma_unlock_all_v1='1' for Shred City.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Avatar feature is production-ready. useAvatar reads from jma_avatar_v1; writes propagate via internal listener Set + localStorage. isOutfitUnlocked uses rankIndex (via useRank → achievement-set) + earned stickers. Badge-unlock requires reaching Tadpole (1 Cadet achievement). Confirmed sharky-hiphop + 5 disco variants unlock on first badge → 14/30 total. CrowdRow accepts avatarSrc and inserts {you:true} at index 3 — total 7 members preserved. Pre-existing 'duplicate key' React warning is unrelated to avatars.
